Privacy by architecture

This candidate does not collect your answers.

The application is delivered as static HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a versioned question set. It has no form endpoint, database, account system, telemetry, or third-party scripts.

  • Answers are kept in JavaScript memory during the open session.
  • No answers are written to browser storage automatically.
  • No network connections are permitted by the page security policy.
  • Downloaded working files remain under your custody.
  • Sharing with QuietWire is a separate, deliberate act outside this first release.

QuietWire Discovery — a local-first public instrument.
